name: compact-archive
description: Compact early to save cost without losing anything: archive every transcript before compaction (PreCompact hook) and a skill that sets a smaller auto-compact window (500k by default, or chosen by a smart analysis of your own sessions' cost and output quality) and adds compaction rules to CLAUDE.md; after every compaction, a hook reminds Claude to re-read code interfaces and lists the real definition lines of the files in use.
